name: znetwork_dplay_create_lobby3a_interface
description: zNetworkDPlay::CreateLobby3AInterface creates a DirectPlay lobby interface and queries IDirectPlayLobby3A.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x48be10 validates the fastcall outLobby3A argument, DirectPlayLobbyCreateA provider call with null guid/outer/data and flags 0, QueryInterface for IID_IDirectPlayLobby3A on successful lobby creation, Release of the base lobby only after successful QueryInterface, outLobby3A storage only on success, and HRESULT return propagation for provider/query failures.
Native smoke znetwork_dplay_create_lobby3a_interface_smoke patches DirectPlayLobbyCreateA and verifies create failure, QueryInterface failure, and success with Release plus out pointer assignment.
